political_system.executive: Prime Minister is Head of Government exercising executive power, leading the Council of Ministers accountable to the Lok Sabha; President of India serves as Head of State with constitutional reserve powers.
political_system.legislature: Bicameral Parliament (Sansad): Lok Sabha (543 directly elected members from single-member constituencies) and Rajya Sabha (245 members representing the states and union territories).
political_system.judiciary: Unified, independent federal judiciary headed by the Supreme Court of India with extensive judicial review authority, fundamental rights enforcement, and appointment authority via the collegium system.
political_system.structure: Quasi-federal union comprising 28 states and 8 union territories, with defined central, state, and concurrent legislative competencies.
political_system.election_system: Universal adult suffrage administered by the autonomous Election Commission of India (ECI); first-past-the-post plurality voting in the world's largest democratic electoral exercises.

current_government.ruling_coalition: National Democratic Alliance (NDA), led by the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)
current_government.prime_minister: Narendra Modi (serving historic third consecutive term)
current_government.context: Following the 2024 general elections, the BJP governs as the anchor of the NDA coalition, pursuing national infrastructure development, high-tech manufacturing, defense self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat), and expansive digital public infrastructure rollout.
current_government.main_opposition: Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA bloc), led by the Indian National Congress (INC)

major_parties.name: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)
major_parties.ideology: Cultural nationalism (Hindutva), economic modernization, robust defense posture, social welfare delivery via digital cash transfers
major_parties.status: Lead party of the governing NDA coalition

major_parties.name: Indian National Congress (INC)
major_parties.ideology: Center-left secularism, constitutional rights, redistributive social justice, welfare guarantees

major_parties.name: Regional Parties (TDP, JD(U), DMK, TMC, AAP)
major_parties.ideology: Regional federalism, linguistic representation, state-specific development priorities
major_parties.status: Critical coalition anchors in both government and opposition

political_movements_and_dynamics.name: Viksit Bharat 2047 (Developed India)
political_movements_and_dynamics.description: Grand national vision aiming to transform India into a high-income, fully developed nation by the centenary of its independence in 2047, focusing on capital expenditure, semiconductor hubs, and energy transition.
political_movements_and_dynamics.current_relevance: Directs tens of billions in public capital investment into railways, expressways, ports, and aerospace R&D.

political_movements_and_dynamics.name: Atmanirbhar Bharat (Self-Reliant India)
political_movements_and_dynamics.description: Strategic industrial policy utilizing Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes to localize manufacturing of mobile phones, electronics, defense hardware, and solar modules, curbing import dependency.
political_movements_and_dynamics.current_relevance: Subsidizes domestic defense manufacturing and incentivizes multinational supply chain moves from China to India.

political_movements_and_dynamics.name: Digital Public Infrastructure (India Stack)
political_movements_and_dynamics.description: State-backed open-source digital architecture comprising Aadhaar (biometrics), UPI (instant payments), and DigiLocker, driving financial inclusion and eliminating leakages in direct benefit transfers.
political_movements_and_dynamics.current_relevance: Enables unprecedented efficiency in welfare delivery while catalyzing one of the world's most vibrant fintech startup ecosystems.
